title: Feed / Inbox / Notification Producer Census and Ownership Coherence

producers.observed: Append-only hash-chained event/evidence history with operation/correlation/causation fields.
Notification OPEN/ACKNOWLEDGED/ESCALATED/RESOLVED/SUPPRESSED state, acknowledgement deadlines, bounded escalation, dedupe and delivery attempts.
Deterministic read-only decision ranking, reconciliation, supersession, explanations, recommendations and relationship projection.
Visible Feed cards, local persistence, unread/read state, drawer rendering and titan:feed event ingestion.
External communications intent family exists separately from operational Feed; later passes will preserve that separation and deep-linking.

verified_gaps: Ownership semantics were implicit across Feed, Decision Feed, Workforce notifications and Event Ledger.
Visible Feed is a presentation/read-state store but could be misread as lifecycle authority.
Unified Decision Feed is richer than visible Feed but remains projection-only and was not tagged with shared ownership metadata.
Workforce notification runtime owns acknowledgement/escalation state but was not tagged with shared ownership metadata.
Chrome notifications permission exists, but Titan Feed itself is not yet a complete delivery fabric; that remains later-pass work.
pass1_change: Added a shared feed-source ownership contract and connected the existing Decision Feed and Workforce notification entrypoints to it without touching active shell/page-wiring hotspots.
next_pass: Pass 2 will define one shared severity/urgency mapping consumed by existing surfaces.
